newsitem.title: FINLAND: METSAMARKKA SEES FIM 2.5-3.0 MLN ONE-OFF COSTS.
newsitem.headline: METSAMARKKA SEES FIM 2.5-3.0 MLN ONE-OFF COSTS.

text.p: Finnish forestry investment company Metsamarkka which is merging with Lannen Metsa and Sijoitus Forestia said on Monday that the merger would cause 2.5 million to 3.0 million markka in one-off costs.
It said it expected stable returns from its long-term investments, and at least four million markka of gains from the sale of shares in Soinlahden Saha.

"On the other hand, earnings will be reduced by the merger considerations and one-off costs from joining the book-entry register, which will rise to about 2.5 million to 3.0 million markka," it said in a statement with its H1 earnings.

Metsamarkka reported first half pretax earnings rising to 3.03 million markka from 4.70 million markka. Lannen Metsa's net profit was 3.2 million markka and Sijoitus Forestia's was 6.0 million markka in the first half, it said.
In 1996, Metsamarkka's pretax profit was 8.1 million markka.
